records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Pharmacology: The Science of Drug Action
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to drug receptors, cell signaling, and drug classes.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Careers: Pathways in Biomedicine
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to careers in biomedical research, pharmaceutical/biotech industry, government, and human health professions.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Biomedical Literature: Communicating Science
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Review and discussion of recent biomedical literature emphasizing oral presentations.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Pharmaceutics: Delivering the Treatment
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to drug absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion; drug delivery; and vaccines.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Medicinal Chemistry: Developing New Drugs
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to drug disposition, drug metabolism, structure-activity relationships, functional groups, and drug development.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Ethics:  Conduct and Career Development
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to biomedical research practices, responsible conduct of research, scientific writing, and biomedical ethics.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Molecular Methods: Biochemical Techniques
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to methodological approaches commonly used in pharmaceutical research and biotechnology.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Equity, Disparity, and Social Justice in Healthcare
records.description: Fundamental concepts of social justice and equity in healthcare, with a solution-focused approach.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Genomics: Frontiers in Human Genetics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to genetics and pharmacogenomics, with examples from human medicine and consideration of ethics.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Healthcare Systems: Tackling Human Health
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to healthcare systems, workforce, financing, policy, and delivery with discussions of current challenges.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Foundational Human Immunology
records.description: Foundations of human immunology for the health sciences including immune system components and processes, innate and adaptive immunity, pathogen response, autoimmunity, vaccinations, and cancer immunotherapy. Recommended preparation: TMP 350 or a similar course in biochemistry.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Scientific Communication: Writing and Speaking
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to scientific writing and oral communications in the biomedical sciences.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Medical Microbiology: Bugs and Drugs
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to immunology, bacteriology, virology, mycology, parasitology, and drugs used to treat infectious diseases.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Toxicology: Assessing Drug Side Effects
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to toxicology, with an emphasis on the side effects of drugs used to treat human disease.  Credit not granted for both PHARMEDS 444 and PHARMEDS 544.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Cancer Biology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program.
records.description: Introduction to contemporary cancer biology covering fundamental hallmarks of cancer biology, from the discovery of oncogenes to cancer initiation, metastasis, and treatment.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Lab Medicine Internship I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program and accepted into the Providence School of Medical Laboratory Science (SMLS).
records.description: Part one of a laboratory internship covering the theories, concepts, and practices of Medical Laboratory Science.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Lab Medicine Internship II
records.description: Part two of a laboratory internship covering the theories, concepts, and practices of Medical Laboratory Science.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Lab Medicine Internship III
records.description: Part three of a laboratory internship covering the theories, concepts, and practices of Medical Laboratory Science.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Lab Medicine Review
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the Pharmaceutical and Medical Sciences BS program and accepted into the Providence School of Medical Laboratory Science (SMLS).
records.description: Review and comprehensive examination covering the theories, concepts, and practices of Medical Laboratory Science.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Senior Seminar: Capstone Experience
records.description: Culminating and integrative experience with senior thesis; discussion of current topics in biomedicine and presentation of senior projects.

records.subject: PHARMEDS
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
